brief: 面向AI行业活动现场的约3分钟观猹业务介绍漫剧；轻喜剧，懂行、机灵、办事靠谱。视觉调性待确认；以跨社区、模型工作台、商务场景的一致性测试为目标。

prompts.A:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: visual consistency test board for a 3-minute animated brand film, shown at an AI industry event. This is a proposed look, not approved production artwork.
Input references: image 1 is the canonical Chacha mascot identity (white round animal, small rounded ears, black dot eyes, small black nose and friendly curved smile, huge striped tail, mint-green T-shirt, little rounded hands). Image 2 is the canonical Chamei identity (human girl character with chestnut fringe and side locks, orange-brown bear-ear hood, black small oval eyes, tiny nose, peach cheeks and rounded hands). Preserve Chamei's supplied upper-body design; frame her behind a counter, no invented full-body costume. Image 3 is the canonical suited Chacha pair (same white mascot heads, black suits, white shirts, ties). They are business representatives, not Chamei.
Deliver ONE coherent widescreen 16:9 art-direction board, very high detail, a clean 2-by-2 grid with thin off-white gutters and NO title banner. Top left, top right and bottom left are three equally sized cinematic 16:9 scene frames from the SAME film. Bottom right is a compact visual continuity key: two close-up portraits (Chacha and Chamei) in the EXACT same style as the scenes, a silhouette of the large striped tail, and 4 small color swatches. Tiny panel labels only: "01", "02", "03", "STYLE A/B" as specified below. No other text, brand slogans, UI text, lettering or watermarks.
Scene 01, community: Chacha and Chamei at a playful AI product demo counter with three large rounded product/review cards (simple icon graphics, no words), one tilted card causing Chacha's mildly surprised expression; Chamei calmly gestures toward the cards. A modest stylized indoor community space, no crowds.
Scene 02, model workbench: the EXACT same Chacha and Chamei at a rounded tabletop connecting one green cable from a simple key-shaped connector to several large modular blocks bearing minimal text/image/sound pictograms. The cable is an explanatory visual metaphor, not a realistic product UI. Bright curious expressions, a few oversized readable props. Keep Chacha's shirt, head/body proportion, eye spacing, tail design, Chamei's hood and face identical to scene 01.
Scene 03, business: the two suited white Chacha representatives from reference 3 stand at a simple rounded collaboration counter, one handing over a plain folder, the other gesturing to a large abstract product launch display. They have the SAME facial vocabulary and rendering language as green-shirt Chacha. Warm, capable, lightly humorous, not solemn or aggressively corporate.
Across all three scenes: unified eye-level medium-wide camera, consistent mascot scale, identical edge treatment, simple readable event-screen compositions, strong silhouette separation and uncluttered backgrounds. Palette anchored in mint and vivid green, warm white, charcoal; orange-brown reserved for Chamei's hood. No neon cyberpunk, dense dashboards, realistic human skin, anime eyes, fur strands, glass skyscrapers or stock-photo offices. All characters belong to the same designed world.
STYLE A: translate ALL reference assets, including the 3D suit characters, into a refined 2D hand-drawn animation style close to reference 1. Bold gently irregular black ink outlines, flat cream-white and mint-green color fills, restrained single-tone cel shadows, minimal hand-painted texture. Elegant spacious adult-facing brand cartoon rather than a children's activity book. Buildings, furniture, cards and people use the same outline weight family and flat perspective language. NO 3D lighting or rendered plastic anywhere. Label the continuity panel "STYLE A".
